description: This file contains implementations for creating and managing EventHub partition checkpointers in Azure Table Storage within the Orleans streaming framework. It defines the factory for producing checkpointer instances and the checkpointer class itself, responsible for storing, loading, and updating checkpoint information asynchronously.

classes.name: EventHubCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Factory class that creates EventHub checkpointer instances with specified options and cluster configurations.

classes.name: EventHubCheckpointer
classes.description: Manages checkpoint storage for a specific EventHub partition, allowing load and update of checkpoint offsets stored in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and initializes an EventHubCheckpointer instance.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for event hub checkpointers given a service provider and provider name.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the current checkpoint offset for the partition from Azure table storage.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint offset in Azure table storage, respecting throttling intervals.
